limitations: Preparation consumes only bounded JSON-safe descriptor and namespace facts and never receives live CASC, archive, filesystem or installation capabilities.
Installed CASC is the primary supported subject: roots are proved only by observed Objects, Regions and t3HeightMap documents, and a truncated listing never causes an implicit first-map choice.

The current 4096-entry product root listing ends before the pinned Liberty/TArcade map; a bounded host prefix-discovery round is required to expose deeper CASC map roots without enumerating the full installation.

A standalone sc2-map is prepared only when its opened codec publishes both namespace-entry-source and container.extract; the current packed SC2Map codec extracts stored single-unit entries, while compressed, encrypted and sector-based map documents remain explicit remainders.
A loose SC2Map directory keeps the active map in the opened namespace and asks the trusted host resolver to prefer exact installed dependency directories before the installed CASC namespace.
Transitive DocumentInfo closure for loose external dependencies, unresolved Battle.net-only dependencies, and native map launch remain named remainders.
The provider validates opaque selectionId continuation; application callers must preserve the exact subject revision and resubmit only an id returned for that revision.
